evaluations.name: High Priority Email
evaluations.simulationInstructions: ReadLatestOutlookEmail tool should return a high-priority email with urgent content.
evaluations.expectedAgentBehavior: The agent should categorize the email as 'High Priority' based on its urgent content and move it to the 'High Priority' folder.
